subject: Measure single-brand vs pooled training cost
description:
P0036 task 7. Measurement, not decision -- Brian decides on the numbers.

Fit both on Faxe Kondi (pooled-then-predict vs single-brand-only), compare WMAPE.

Prior measurement already shows the single-brand premise does not hold: pooled = 3,392 rows / 85 brands vs single = 44 rows. Selecting the highest-data brand yields NO additional data, since 51 brands already sit at the 44-month ceiling and MIN_PERIODS filters series LENGTH. 44 rows x ~30 features is unfittable for XGBoost/LightGBM.

Recommended resolution to confirm: separate training scope (pooled) from evaluation scope (Faxe Kondi).

Verify: WMAPE comparison table in findings.md; feeds Ch4 + Ch10 limitations.
